FX-BEZIER-001.says: The settings as they start: the drawing, untouched.

FX-BEZIER-002.says: The top left vertex pulled in to (25, 25), the tangents left where they start: the top and left edges bend in to meet it, and the corner it left is clear.

FX-BEZIER-003.says: Both top tangents pulled down to 60 per cent: the top edge sags into the drawing in a curve, the band of rows above it clear, deepest in the middle.

FX-BEZIER-004.says: Both right tangents pulled in to 50 per cent across: the right edge pinched in to a curve, the right middle columns clear.

FX-BEZIER-005.says: FX-BEZIER-003 at Quality 1: the same sag cut into 4 by 4 cells, so its curve is a coarser chain of straight pieces and the frame differs.

FX-BEZIER-006.says: An S: the top edge's tangents at 50 and -50 per cent down, the bottom's at 150 and 50: both edges wave the same way, the stripes between bent into an S.

FX-BEZIER-007.says: Every point moved into the square from 25 to 75 per cent, the tangents still at the thirds: no curve, the drawing at half its size in the middle, as an even squeeze draws it.

FX-BEZIER-008.says: Every point mirrored left for right in place: the outline is the same square, run the other way, so the drawing is drawn mirrored.

FX-BEZIER-009.says: The top left vertex keyed from (0, 0) at frame 0 to (25, 25) at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 4 FX-BEZIER-002, frame 2 half way.

FX-BEZIER-010.says: FX-BEZIER-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the bent drawing moves with it.

FX-BEZIER-011.says: The bottom right vertex dragged past the top left one to (-20, -20): the outline folds over itself; where it overlaps, the part later in the grid is drawn on top.

FX-BEZIER-012.says: Quality keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4, eased past its end, with the sag: frame 2 would pass 10 and is held there, the same as frame 4.

FX-BEZIER-013.says: The left top tangent flung out to (300, -200): the left edge loops far out past the drawing and back, and what is bent past the edges is cut off.

FX-BEZIER-014.says: Quality 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEZIER-015.says: Quality 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEZIER-016.says: The top left vertex at (-401, 0), its x below -400. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEZIER-017.says: The bottom left tangent keyed to (100, 600) at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
